nodes.title: Workflow guide
widgets_values:
# Built-in voice (ip)

[Custom node](https://github.com/Saganaki22/ComfyUI-Ming-3-tts) · [Model files](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Ming-3.0-tts-ComfyUI/tree/main/checkpoints)

`ip` selects an official named voice. **US_James** is the example value; choose a voice name supported by the checkpoint. No recording or transcript is required.

1. Select or download a model.
2. Enter the new speech in **text**.
3. Leave `task=ip`, select the voice and queue.

## Generation settings
- **seed 42 / fixed** keeps the seed unchanged between runs.
- **cfg 2** controls guidance. **flow_steps 10** sets solver work per chunk.
- **temperature 0** disables extra stochastic flow noise; `sigma` matters when temperature is above zero.
- **max_steps 250** caps audio chunks at about 20 seconds; the model can stop earlier. It does not set speaking speed or force a duration.
- **trim** removes trailing quiet audio. The terminal shows chunk progress, it/s and generation time.
- **Save Audio** previews the result and writes FLAC under `ComfyUI/output/ming_tts/`.

nodes.title: Model files and setup
widgets_values:
## Ming model downloads

- [Ming-3.0-tts-0.5b](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Ming-3.0-tts-ComfyUI/resolve/main/checkpoints/Ming-3.0-tts-0.5b/model.safetensors?download=true)
- [Ming-3.0-tts-0.5b-int8-convrot](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Ming-3.0-tts-ComfyUI/resolve/main/checkpoints/Ming-3.0-tts-0.5b-int8-convrot/ming-3-tts-0.5b-int8-convrot.safetensors?download=true)
- [Ming-3.0-tts-tiny-9b](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Ming-3.0-tts-ComfyUI/resolve/main/checkpoints/Ming-3.0-tts-tiny-9b/ming-3-tts-tiny-9b.safetensors?download=true)
- [Ming-3.0-tts-tiny-9b-int8-convrot](https://huggingface.co/drbaph/Ming-3.0-tts-ComfyUI/resolve/main/checkpoints/Ming-3.0-tts-tiny-9b-int8-convrot/ming-3-tts-tiny-9b-int8-convrot.safetensors?download=true)

## Model folders
Place each selected weight in its matching folder:
```
ComfyUI/models/checkpoints/
├── Ming-3.0-tts-0.5b/model.safetensors
├── Ming-3.0-tts-0.5b-int8-convrot/
│   └── ming-3-tts-0.5b-int8-convrot.safetensors
├── Ming-3.0-tts-tiny-9b/
│   └── ming-3-tts-tiny-9b.safetensors
└── Ming-3.0-tts-tiny-9b-int8-convrot/
    └── ming-3-tts-tiny-9b-int8-convrot.safetensors
```
Only the chosen model is needed. Keep this custom node's bundled `assets` folder installed; it supplies config/tokenizer files and CampPlus.

**download_if_missing** is off initially. Enable it to authorize downloading the selected missing model. Existing local models, registered extra paths, symlinks and junctions work.

**0.5B** is the smaller option. **Tiny 9B** is required for native podcast dialogue. INT8 reduces weight storage and memory; it is not a guaranteed speedup. Precision controls computation, not the saved weight format. `auto` follows ComfyUI's device/dtype selection.

Tiny uses optional FLA kernels on compatible CUDA systems, otherwise the slower PyTorch fallback. The terminal reports the backend used. Output is mono 44.1 kHz.

nodes.title: Built-in voice catalog
widgets_values:
## Built-in voice names (task ip)
Type the exact identifier in **voice**. No reference recording or transcript is needed.

| Voice | Character |
| --- | --- |
| `US_Emma` | Female, American English |
| `US_James` | Male, American English |
| `US_Stella` | Female, American English |
| `UK_George` | Male, British English |
| `UK_Charlotte` | Female, British English |

Chinese examples: `灵小安`, `灵小柔`, `灵楷`. Some voices need an exact emotion-specific identifier, for example `灵未央_高兴` or `灵未央_中性`. Use the listed invocation name; do not translate it or invent a suffix. Keep task `ip` for these identifiers.

The [official voice catalog](https://github.com/inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-tts/blob/main/cookbooks/instruction_en.md#built-in-premium-voices) contains the 100+ Chinese voices and their variants. These identifiers are documented upstream; the speech checks here used `US_James`.
